title: Fix Sketchpad Styling Consistency With Play Site
description: compose sites play is styled properly but dev compose sketchpad looks terrible. Make sure sketchpad always looks consistent by investigating styling differences between play and sketchpad.
summary: Added missing Tailwind CSS v4 @source directives to sketchpad/globals.css and desktop/globals.css. Without these directives, Tailwind was not scanning elements/ui, compose/ui, compose/js component files for class names, resulting in missing generated CSS. Now both sketchpad and play produce nearly identical CSS output (~184-185KB).
